title: X+1 Heads Are Better Than X

entities.name: Protean Hydra
entities.description: A Magic 2010 hydra creature that sprouts new heads when damaged, growing larger instead of dying from non-lethal wounds.

entities.name: Heracles
entities.description: The Greek hero of myth, who slew monsters and cauterized the hydra's neck-wounds.

entities.name: Perseus
entities.description: A Greek hero of myth, as played by Harry Hamlin in Clash of the Titans.

entities.name: Medusa
entities.description: A monster of Greek myth recalled by the author.

entities.name: Kraken
entities.description: A monster of Greek myth recalled by the author.

entities.name: Minotaur
entities.description: A monster of legend the author read about.

events.summary: The author recalls reading about Greek myth monsters such as the Kraken, Medusa and the Minotaur as a child.
events.quote: I devoured legends of the Minotaur, of harpies and centaurs, and of the Phoenix and the Cyclops as imagination nourishment.

events.summary: The column describes how facing a hydra works: nonlethal strikes only produce a scarier hydra.
events.quote: All you end up with is an even scarier hydra than you started with.

events.summary: The column notes Heracles ultimately cauterized the hydra's neck-wounds.
events.quote: which, we might say, cauterizes those neck-wounds just like Heracles ultimately did
